summary: US equities sold off on Nov 16 (Nasdaq Composite -2.49%, S&P 500 -1.92%) as Nvidia's CEO exit, rising Treasury yields and prospective tighter China chip export curbs weighed on tech. Markets price a near-certain Fed rate hike in December after hot inflation data and hawkish FOMC remarks; the dollar hit a 19-month high and AUD was the weakest major. WTI fell 3.2% to ~$85.7 on supply-glut forecasts and gold touched its lowest level since Oct 2025. Bitcoin held near $64.9k after a weekend low near $62k. Key events this week: US retail sales, industrial production, Philly Fed, and an anticipated Anthropic IPO.
